title: LESta bootstrap installer result
description: The single JSON object install.sh prints on stdout for every invocation (--version, --dry-run, --apply, and every failure path), matching INSTALLER-CONTRACT.md's 'Output and exit codes' example exactly, plus the item shapes for changes[] and errors[].

status.description: ok: --version. applied: a completed --apply run. would_change: a completed --dry-run (a fresh/repair/upgrade classification and the changes it would make are reported in changes[], never applied). failed: preflight, verification, mutation, or health failure in any mode.

exit_code.description: Matches INSTALLER-CONTRACT.md's exit code table exactly: 0 success/valid dry-run, 10 invalid invocation or manifest, 11 unsupported platform or architecture, 12 preflight conflict or insufficient capacity, 13 verification/signature/checksum failure, 20 package or filesystem mutation failure, 21 service validation or health failure, 22 rollback or recovery failure, 30 interrupted or incomplete run requiring recovery.

capability.description: One of this manifest set's own capability ids (e.g. base.os.v1, firewall.baseline.v1, node.health.v1, web.nginx.v1), naming which capability this change belongs to.

action.description: A short verb-phrase describing what happened or would happen, e.g. created, verified, ensured, applied, enabled, installed, installed_structural_only, validated, healthy, would_install, would_ensure, would_apply.

path.description: The filesystem path this change concerns, or an empty string when the change is not path-scoped (e.g. a package installation or a health probe).

detail.description: A human-readable explanation of what actually happened (or, in --dry-run, what would happen), redacted at the logging boundary the same as every other diagnostic string.

code.description: A short machine-matchable error code, e.g. invalid_invocation, unsupported_os, unsupported_architecture, insufficient_disk, insufficient_inodes, port_occupied, conflicting_package, conflicting_service, conflicting_identity, nginx_conf_missing, nginx_conf_missing_include, checksum_mismatch, apt_install_failed, nginx_test_failed, selftest_agent_failed, selftest_not_applied.

path.description: The filesystem path this error concerns, or an empty string when not path-scoped.
